description: This file defines API routes for managing and executing test runs in a testing platform, including starting test runs, retrieving results, and batch queuing.

methods.name: execute_test_run
methods.description: Background task to execute a test run, update status, save artifacts, and cleanup.

methods.name: create_run
methods.description: API endpoint to create and start a test run for a robot test file.

methods.name: run_testcase
methods.description: API endpoint to execute a specific test case from a robot test file.

methods.name: list_runs
methods.description: API endpoint to list all test runs with optional filtering.

methods.name: get_run
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve details of a specific test run.

methods.name: get_run_logs
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve presigned URLs and log content for a test run.

methods.name: queue_batch_execution
methods.description: API endpoint to queue multiple test files or test cases for execution.
